scenes.keyframe_visual: Arjun hunched at his laptop, IT security email glowing, a 7:04pm tracker entry flagged under his login, protein bar wrapper crushed by the keyboard

dialogue.line: Seven pm? I left office by six that day.

scenes.micro_acting: jaw tightens, he scrolls down once, rereads his own name, leans back slowly

scenes.keyframe_visual: Anu paying the vendor for chai, steam rising off the glass, Arjun walking up behind her with his laptop bag
scenes.camera: static wide, cutting to medium two-shot as he arrives

dialogue.line: Anu. Tracker says I made your mistake.
dialogue.voice: Indian man, late 20s, smooth confident sales register, quick laughs

dialogue.line: What mistake? I don't know what you mean.

scenes.micro_acting: Anu's hand freezes mid-sip, she lowers the glass slowly and glances at him
scenes.narrative_job: Arjun confronts Anu directly with the timestamp evidence

scenes.keyframe_visual: Arjun leaning on the stall counter, arms crossed, Anu gripping her glass tighter as steam drifts between them
scenes.camera: static medium two-shot, slow dolly in

dialogue.line: Come on. You and Sethi sir, door shut, past seven. Every night.
dialogue.voice: Indian man, late 20s, smooth confident sales register, quick laughs

dialogue.line: It's work, Arjun. I don't owe you an explanation.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

dialogue.line: Strategy reviews don't need closed doors, Anu.
dialogue.voice: Indian man, late 20s, smooth confident sales register, quick laughs

scenes.micro_acting: Anu forces a flat stare, chin lifts slightly, knuckles whiten on the glass
scenes.narrative_job: Arjun voices his suspicion about the secret deal directly, Anu holds the cover story

scenes.keyframe_visual: Arjun stepping closer, lowering his voice, vendor clanking tumblers behind them, Anu's glass set down hard on the counter
scenes.camera: slow dolly in on both faces

dialogue.line: I heard you were counting cash behind this stall. Don't make me ask who from.
dialogue.voice: Indian man, late 20s, smooth confident sales register, quick laughs
young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

dialogue.line: Pad my invoice. Same way you padded that tracker.

scenes.micro_acting: Anu's breath catches, she sets the glass down hard, Arjun watches her and waits

scenes.keyframe_visual: Anu standing alone with the stairwell to the office behind her, tote strap gripped tight, Arjun still waiting at the counter

dialogue.line: I need to think about this, okay?

scenes.micro_acting: she swallows hard, eyes flick toward the stairwell, doesn't look at him
scenes.narrative_job: cliffhanger - will Anu give in or report him to Vikram
